notes: Base second-edition assets; explicit localized inventory/turn-order variants are not silently treated as all English components.
Mage starting breach faces/rotation/chargecapacity and deck order are actual selected-profile state, not guessed defaults.
All four players have independent hand/deck/discard/prepared/played zones; hidden order is preserved without forced disclosure.
Linear15husk count and dynamiccharge well are original equivalent state representations, not made-up official grids or copied board art.
Physical neutral placeholders do not create actual current cards/tokens.
Completion refers to full asset/state package; Claude app connection and card effect rules are separate.

structureEvidence.access: 20pages downloaded/text extracted; component/mage/breach/setup/turn-order diagrams directly viewed
structureEvidence.verifiedFacts: Up to4mages; four ordered breach positions with absent/open/closed/rotated state;3/2/4supply; separatehand/deck/discard/played; never shuffle personaldeck; ordered nemesis minions/powers; Gravehold and nemesis life; special Fury/husk forms.

structureEvidence.access: core8mages/4nemeses/market information and source screenshots directly viewed
structureEvidence.location: base-game contents and core mechanics sections
structureEvidence.verifiedFacts: Exact8base mage names,4nemesis identities; variable turnorder and preserved discard order; RageborneStrike versus PrinceDevour structure. Digital interface not treated as printed mat geometry.

structureEvidence.location: KönigderMasken/Corruption and spell discard timing clarifications
structureEvidence.verifiedFacts: Corruptions exist as cards that can be affected by discard/destroy effects; cast spell already in discard when resolving effect. No card-text effect engine is embedded.

assetScope: Second-edition base full1–4mage table and four mutually exclusive nemesis presentations, all personal deck/order/hand/breach/charge and shared market/life/turn state; assets only.

tableModel.edition: AeonsEnd2nd-edition base; English IBCAED2 core with explicit localized Frosted2020 inventory/options profile. No WarEternal/NewAge/Legacy content.

coordinates.wholeTable: all four independent mage boards/breaches/prepped spells/hand/deck/discard/played area; shared nine piles, nemesis ordered row, life dials, turn cards and destroyed cards
coordinates.presentation: Original neutral geometry. Mage portrait/ability artwork not reproduced; charge counts are dynamic actual-profile data. Husk positions use an original linear ordered count display, not a reproduction or adjacency map.

breachGeometry.closedSectorDirection: rotation records actual tile orientation, not number of actions automatically paid
breachGeometry.spells: stable spell card IDs attach to breach ID/IDs, with independent offsets/rotation/layer; preserve actual special permissions rather than a fake one-spell UI limit

supply.emptyPile: remains same supply identity with zero cards; do not refill/replace automatically
supply.capacityMeaning: each visual slot is one pile, not a one-card maximum

frosted2020.includedExtras: localized13turncards/7numbertokens contain optional variants; not forced into an English9turncard set. Some expansion storage aids bundled; excluded from game-table setup.

editionProfiles.activation: Choose the physical copy/turn-order variant actually used. The state records the selected card multiset and difficulty. It does not silently replace original turn cards with localized variants.

identityAndOrder: A personal deck is never shuffled on refill. Flip the whole discard preserving its physical order; previously bottom discard becomes top draw. Record partial refill to prevent flipping twice.
Only turn-order deck shuffles at its cycle; the nemesis deck preserves tier ordering after initial construction. Separate strike/corruption reshuffle rules belong to selected nemesis checkpoints.
A cast spell goes to discard before its cast effect resolves; its physical card ID is not duplicated in breach and discard. Preserve exceptions that keep it prepared.
Purchased cards normally join discard; effects can change destination. Do not repair a legal exception to the default.
Prepared-spell cards, breach tiles and their open/closed focus orientation are independent. Exhaustion destroys an actual chosen breach; absent and destroyed differ.
Nemesis powers and minions resolve in actual played order, with health and countdown attached to individual cards. More artwork is not extra active enemy cards.

nemesisDisplaySemantics.rageborne: separate Fury collection,Strike deck and currentStrike; count not inferred from3guide tokens
nemesisDisplaySemantics.carapace-queen: fifteen individual husk-token positions with stable IDs and life; linear presentation counts only, no movement adjacency or invented printed layout
nemesisDisplaySemantics.prince-of-gluttons: separate ordered devoured pile linked to source supply card instances, not a new unowned discard
nemesisDisplaySemantics.crooked-mask: separate corruption deck and pending source/recipient/return flow; corruption in a hand/deck/discard remains that same physical card, not duplicated in nemesis tray

tableModel.privacy: Public mage/prepared/played/discard states versus scoped hand/draw order. Cooperative agreed-open hand is an explicit mode. Hidden nemesis/turn/strike/corruption order stays unknown unless authorized recorded. 0andnull remain distinct.

fieldBindings.discard.scene: played plus ordered discard, kept separate by zoneId

tableModel.notAutomated: No complete card-text/profile-cost database, legal focus/open/charge rules, card selection, enemy/swarm/unleash resolution, damage/healing/forced exhaustion, automatic deck reconstruction or win/loss. Only whole physical/state assets.

completeStructures: four full mage stations with up-to4physical breaches each
prepared spells as a separate attached layer
selected nemesis mat/2life dials/ordered minion-power row
four distinct nemesis-specific physical card/token trays
notIncluded: commercial card text/art or all profile costs
displayChoices: Whole-table seating and linear husk count are original presentation geometry, not asserted facsimile printed boards.
Mage charging is a variable token well; actual capacity comes from selected physical mage, not a fabricated common printed track.
